verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own docs describe Scheduled Flags, which queue flag changes and apply them automatically at a specified future time. That covers the one-off, future-time flag-change part of the story. Release Pipelines automate stage progression via triggers, but the evidence never says those triggers can be set to a specific future time, so scheduling releases (beyond individual flag changes) is not shown. missing for 10: explicit time-based scheduling of releases or pipeline stages, details on scheduling scope (segments, values, environments) and API support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Scheduled flags allow you to queue and automatically apply changes to feature flags at a specified future time, eliminating the need for manual intervention at the exact moment of change.
Define stages that your flags progress through automatically, with triggers and actions that control rollouts to selected environments and audiences.
